title: echium biebersteinii
intro: Echium biebersteinii, commonly known as Purple Viper's Bugloss or Pride of Turkey, is a flowering plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is often used to support cardiovascular health, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant's bioactive constituents also include echinacoside, a glycoside that has been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
